correctness.rationale: The six Köhler–Lutz 6-vertex facet representatives expanded under translations x->x+a and multipliers 1,3,9 mod13 produce 156 facets and f=(13,78,286,533,468,156), hence every vertex triple is a triangle and 715-533=182 four-sets are missing tetrahedra. Independent exact F2 elimination on every triangle-to-edge boundary gives rank 66 and tetra-to-triangle rank 219, so H2(K;F2)=F2. All 182 tetrahedral boundaries of missing four-sets are nonzero modulo the span of 533 existing tetrahedral boundaries, whereas the present tetrahedra are boundaries. Any simplicial nonzero 2-cycle needs at least 4 vertices. From published integral H1=0 and H2=Z/2, universal coefficients identify the mod-two generator with the unique integral torsion class, with no illicit F2-to-integral inference. Independently formed all 39 affine action permutations and computed exactly 6 missing-four-set orbits (13,13,39,39,39,39), the six claimed representatives and pair signatures 3:3,3:3,4:2,3:3,3:3,2:4. Exhaustiveness is finite exact, not a sampling argument.

Value attaches to the complete essential-carrier result; the published f-vector alone is not claimed novel.
